# agent-mesh

> Orchestrate multiple Agent CLIs into a dispatchable, verifiable, traceable multi-agent network. 把多台 Agent CLI 编排成可调度、可验收、可追溯的协作网络。

## Core

- Task-card JSON → worker dispatch → machine verification → persisted results
- Serial pipelines (`{{prev_output}}`) and parallel DAGs (`depends_on`, `{{nodes.N.output}}`)
- Every run emits a flow diagram; ledger.jsonl records all runs with tokens/cost

## Key files

- run_worker.sh — single-task adapter; header comment is the task-card schema (source of truth)
- run_pipeline.sh — serial multi-node runner
- run_dag.py — DAG parallel runner with topological layers
- mesh_board.py — ops board (history/tokens/trends)
- AGENTS.md — guide for AI agents entering this repo
- docs/WORKERS.md — how to add a new worker CLI
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — design decisions

## Workers

dsh (DeepSeek Harness) · codex (OpenAI) · opencode · hermes · arkcli (Volcano Ark/Doubao) · claude (credential-gated on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

## Quick start

./scripts/setup.sh && ./run_worker.sh examples/tasks/002-ping-dsh.json
